== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Sai'torr Kal Fas (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)|Sai'torr Kal Fas]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://swccgcards.com/product/jpn-premiere-wb-ls-sai-torr-kal-fas/ SWCCG Cards], [https://swccgcards.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/jpn_premiere_wb_ls_Sai_torr_Kal_Fas.png source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(8, 6, 843, 1194)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>8aa5b2795316de3f6244149423ddf378241d2980a726b09d8a0a5d224979732c</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
